reason: Only adds a local _hours helper in the handlers; all layering, injection and state rules are kept.
api/handlers.py imports Slot from domain.schedule and constructs it directly instead of talking to the application only.
ReminderService.run_for imports adapters.email_notifier and replaces the injected notifier with a new OutboxNotifier, so application depends on adapters and bypasses the injected notifier.
The book handler calls service._appointments.on_day(day), reaching the store through an object reachable from the service.
BookingService.cancel computes the fee with a hard-coded LateCancellationFee(24, 30) instead of the injected policy.
